source.tidewater_analytics.scada_water.f.name: flow_meters
source.tidewater_analytics.scada_water.f.description: Per-minute water SCADA flow meter telemetry across treatment plants and distribution mains.

source.tidewater_analytics.hydraulic.pre.name: pressure_zones
source.tidewater_analytics.hydraulic.pre.description: Pressure zone definitions and modelled pressures from the hydraulic model.

source.tidewater_analytics.lims.water_qu.name: water_quality_samples
source.tidewater_analytics.lims.water_qu.description: Lab Information Management System water quality samples — chemistry, microbiology, regulatory analytes.

source.tidewater_analytics.ehs.safety_in.name: safety_incidents
source.tidewater_analytics.ehs.safety_in.description: EHS-reported safety incidents — near-miss, recordable, serious-injury classification per OSHA.

source.tidewater_analytics.regulatory.ne.name: nerc_cip_logs
source.tidewater_analytics.regulatory.ne.description: Access and configuration logs for NERC CIP-classified Bulk Electric System assets.

source.tidewater_analytics.finance.gl_en.name: gl_entries
source.tidewater_analytics.finance.gl_en.description: General ledger entries from the ERP — used for rate-case allocations and operational cost reporting.

source.tidewater_analytics.workorders.el.name: electric_jobs
source.tidewater_analytics.workorders.el.description: Electric work orders — outage restoration, planned maintenance, capital projects.

source.tidewater_analytics.workorders.wa.name: water_jobs
source.tidewater_analytics.workorders.wa.description: Water work orders — main breaks, hydrant flushing, service installations.

model.tidewater_analytics.stg_outage_eve.name: stg_outage_events
model.tidewater_analytics.stg_outage_eve.description: Cleansed and typed outage events. Casts timestamps, splits affected-meter array, normalizes cause codes to the SAIDI/SAIFI taxonomy.

model.tidewater_analytics.stg_transforme.name: stg_transformer_loadings
model.tidewater_analytics.stg_transforme.description: Five-minute transformer loading downsampled to fifteen-minute intervals with kVA peak and rolling-hour averages.

model.tidewater_analytics.stg_customer_m.name: stg_customer_master
model.tidewater_analytics.stg_customer_m.description: Cleansed CIS customer master with consistent service-class codes, billing-status flags, premise FK.

model.tidewater_analytics.stg_service_ad.name: stg_service_addresses
model.tidewater_analytics.stg_service_ad.description: Cleansed service addresses with USPS-validated street normalization and lat/long geocoding.

model.tidewater_analytics.stg_meter_read.name: stg_meter_reads_15min
model.tidewater_analytics.stg_meter_read.description: Validated AMI fifteen-minute reads. Drops zero-flow rows for inactive meters and back-fills micro-gaps via linear interpolation.

model.tidewater_analytics.stg_distributi.name: stg_distribution_assets
model.tidewater_analytics.stg_distributi.description: GIS distribution assets with type taxonomy normalized to the joint-pole / overhead / underground classification used in reliability reporting.

model.tidewater_analytics.stg_water_main.name: stg_water_mains
model.tidewater_analytics.stg_water_main.description: Cleansed water mains with derived age-bucket and Hazen-Williams roughness coefficient lookups.

model.tidewater_analytics.stg_water_qual.name: stg_water_quality_samples
model.tidewater_analytics.stg_water_qual.description: LIMS samples cast to a long-form measurements table with regulatory threshold flagging.

model.tidewater_analytics.stg_pressure_z.name: stg_pressure_zones
model.tidewater_analytics.stg_pressure_z.description: Pressure zones tagged with the parent service area and a normalized 'pressure_class' (low / nominal / high).

model.tidewater_analytics.stg_safety_inc.name: stg_safety_incidents
model.tidewater_analytics.stg_safety_inc.description: Safety incidents standardized to OSHA recordable categories with severity score.

model.tidewater_analytics.int_customer_w.name: int_customer_with_address
model.tidewater_analytics.int_customer_w.description: Customer master joined to its geocoded service address. One row per active customer-premise pairing.

model.tidewater_analytics.int_outage_eve.name: int_outage_events_with_customers
model.tidewater_analytics.int_outage_eve.description: Outage events fanned out to one row per affected customer, with denormalized premise / service class. Feeds SAIDI/SAIFI calculations.

model.tidewater_analytics.int_hourly_met.name: int_hourly_meter_consumption
model.tidewater_analytics.int_hourly_met.description: AMI fifteen-minute reads rolled up to hourly per meter with a forecasted-baseline join.

model.tidewater_analytics.int_water_qual.name: int_water_quality_compliance
model.tidewater_analytics.int_water_qual.description: Joined water quality samples to pressure zones, regulatory thresholds, and the SDWA reporting calendar.

model.tidewater_analytics.int_transforme.name: int_transformer_overload_events
model.tidewater_analytics.int_transforme.description: Transformer loading windows tagged with overload flags when sustained kVA exceeds nameplate by configurable thresholds.

model.tidewater_analytics.mart_electric_.name: mart_electric_outage_summary
model.tidewater_analytics.mart_electric_.description: Daily electric outage summary: customer-minutes-interrupted, event counts by cause, restoration-time histograms. Source for the Outage Dashboard.

model.tidewater_analytics.mart_distribut.name: mart_distribution_reliability
model.tidewater_analytics.mart_distribut.description: SAIDI / SAIFI / CAIDI per substation per month with IEEE 1366-compliant Major Event Day exclusion. Filed with state PUC.

model.tidewater_analytics.mart_customer_.name: mart_customer_billing_anomalies
model.tidewater_analytics.mart_customer_.description: Per-customer billing-cycle anomalies — usage vs. baseline, suspected meter-tamper flags, high-bill alerts.

model.tidewater_analytics.mart_water_qua.name: mart_water_quality_compliance
model.tidewater_analytics.mart_water_qua.description: SDWA-reporting view of water quality: MCL exceedances, compliance ratios per analyte per pressure zone per month.

model.tidewater_analytics.mart_water_dis.name: mart_water_distribution_health
model.tidewater_analytics.mart_water_dis.description: Per pressure-zone health score combining flow telemetry, main-age, break history, and recent compliance.

model.tidewater_analytics.mart_regulator.name: mart_regulatory_kpis
model.tidewater_analytics.mart_regulator.description: Cross-domain regulatory KPI mart — NERC CIP access metrics, SDWA compliance, SAIDI, OSHA recordable rate. One row per month.

seed.tidewater_analytics.sdwa_thresholds.name: sdwa_thresholds
seed.tidewater_analytics.sdwa_thresholds.description: Reference seed: Safe Drinking Water Act maximum contaminant levels by analyte and reporting basis.

seed.tidewater_analytics.nerc_cip_catego.name: nerc_cip_categories
seed.tidewater_analytics.nerc_cip_catego.description: Reference seed: NERC CIP asset categorization buckets (High / Medium / Low Impact) and their reporting obligations.

seed.tidewater_analytics.service_class_c.name: service_class_codes
seed.tidewater_analytics.service_class_c.description: Customer service-class code → human label mapping (RES, COM, IND, MUNI, …).

snapshot.tidewater_analytics.customer_ad.name: customer_address_history
snapshot.tidewater_analytics.customer_ad.description: Slowly-changing-dimension snapshot of customer service addresses. Drives historical attribution of billing anomalies and outages.
